methodology.universe: All 482 canonical emitted entries, E=92 F=142 G=248; every saved signal executed. No filtering, strategy generation, tuning or engine calls.
methodology.source: Phase15 signal_events, trades and correctness_audit.details.signal_atr loaded. Existing causal Indicators functions reconstruct signal context only, after regular-bar filtering.
methodology.reference: Signal N is a completed candle labelled by its start. Execution at physical N+1 open equals signal completion time. A references signal close; B references raw N+1 open. Slipped fill retained separately.
methodology.forward: H=1,2,3,6,12 uses close at entry_index+H-1 = signal_index+H. The entry candle is the first completed future candle. Continue measurement after actual exit, never after regular session ends; unavailable = null. Approximate elapsed horizons 5/10/15/30/60 minutes.
methodology.direction: BUY=future/reference-1; SELL=reference/future-1. Percent tables multiply by 100. ATR moves use (future-reference)/signal_ATR for BUY and (reference-future)/signal_ATR for SELL; this is price-linear, unlike reciprocal SELL percentage.
methodology.statistics: Sample standard deviation ddof=1; linear quantiles; zero return is not positive. Null for unavailable statistics or undefined PF (no gross losses). N always reports actual availability. Net pnl >0 winner, <0 loser; all zero/breakeven groups retained in JSON.
methodology.excursions: Raw entry reference; zero floor. Confirmed lower bound uses all entry-to-pre-exit candles plus exit open and recorded raw exit. EOD includes full final candle. Upper bound additionally uses entire exit-candle high/low, which may occur after fill. Exact pre-exit extrema and ordering are unknowable from OHLC; bounds replace invented precision. In gap exits, confirmed is exact; upper deliberately remains a loose candle bound.
methodology.geometry: Actual levels are around SLIPPED entry: stop 1.5 ATR and target 2 ATR, RR=4/3. Raw-reference threshold diagnostic is separately labelled and censored at actual exit; it is not an alternative backtest. Gap precedes range; STOP wins unresolved same-bar collisions. Full exit-candle raw-threshold probabilities are candle proxies; confirmed-path probabilities and unresolved counts are also provided.
methodology.duration: bars = exit_index-entry_index; minutes = bar-start timestamp difference = bars*5, not precise fill elapsed time. Executable candles = bars+1, so same-entry-candle exit=1 candle, 0 bar-start minutes. Within-N probabilities use candles<=N (within N*5 minutes upper bound). Intrabar actual duration lies between reported minutes and minutes+5; gap exit is at lower bound; EOD at upper bound.
methodology.immediate: Entry candle high/low vs raw entry: favorable/adverse/BOTH/neither. BOTH asserts no sequence. Next-bar close return equals raw-open 1-bar diagnostic, independent of exit.
methodology.characteristics: Only family-used frozen fields: RSI, ATR, ATR/close%, VWAP distance, signal clock minute; E additionally EMA20/50 distances and spread; F Volume/VolumeSMA20 and side-relative OR boundary distance; G EMA20 distance. Distances price units, ATR/close percent, time minutes since midnight; no new indicators. Winner/loser comparison is descriptive, with side splits in JSON.
methodology.time_buckets: Buckets use physical entry time, final bucket ends at regime entry limit. Six entries predate 09:30 (E4, G2); retained in OUTSIDE_PREDEFINED rather than discarded or misassigned. Exact signal cutoffs LEGACY 15:05, CAS 15:00; corresponding entry limits 15:10 and 15:05.
methodology.volatility: Pooled complete 482-trade sample; one linear quantile computation at 1/3 and 2/3; <= lower LOW, <= upper MID, else HIGH. Labels are post-hoc and never signal inputs.
methodology.cost: All saved charges used at full precision. Gross pnl includes slippage and excludes explicit fees. Raw-price pnl minus quantity*(entry_slippage+exit_slippage) equals saved gross. Raw-price pnl holds actual fills/exit levels/quantity/path fixed: not a zero-slippage strategy counterfactual. Ratios use saved fill turnover and absolute saved gross.
methodology.safety: Diagnostic process blocks socket/DNS/process calls and broker/live/SmartAPI imports before project imports. Zero attempts. Regression suite separately has intentional caught network-denial probes and fake historical transport/auth tests; zero external network activity, not zero synthetic test invocations.

limitations: Single instrument and 125 represented sessions; non-independent, overlapping forward windows and many descriptive comparisons. Positive sample means are not established directional alpha or tradability.
Exit-conditioned excursions are censored and subject to exit-bar sequence ambiguity. Target-trade small MAE is also a consequence of stop selection; it cannot justify a different stop.
Horizon availability changes near session end; 12-bar groups differ from 1-bar groups. No overnight carrying or imputation.
Actual intrabar timestamps are unavailable. Duration minutes are bar-start differences with a five-minute interval, not exact fill times.
CAS is only 27 sessions and occurs later chronologically; capital/quantity also decline. Regime pnl differences are not causal effects.

Costs dominate the accounting bridge but gross after slippage is already negative. Positive raw-price accounting for E/F does not establish a profitable no-slippage strategy because actual exit levels and trade selection depended on slipped entries.
No optimized thresholds, alternative rules or versions tested; every bad bucket and losing observation remains included.

common_failure.shared_failure: Weak directional expectancy relative to execution friction; frequent modest favorable excursions are not sustained into sufficient realized reward.
common_failure.directional_alpha: Positive descriptive means exist, most clearly F SELL (all five means positive; 12-bar 67.61% positive). F BUY has negative means/medians at every horizon. G both-side means are negative at every horizon. E changes sign. No independent or economically sufficient alpha established.
common_failure.stops: Confirmed >=0.5 ATR before STOP: E59.62%, F51.19%, G51.23%; >=1 ATR only 30.77%,27.38%,29.01%. Within first candle: 3.85%,10.71%,20.37%. Many modest reversals, not predominantly immediate failures; substantial reversals are a minority.
common_failure.targets: Actual target rates 33.70%,35.21%,31.05%; median confirmed MFE 1.41,1.47,1.08 ATR. Targets are not impossible, but target reach is insufficient. Censoring and weak forward means prevent concluding target/stop geometry is the root cause.
common_failure.costs: Costs are a primary arithmetic contributor, not a small secondary effect: combined slippage+fees about 0.83,0.76,0.86 ATR/trade. Explicit fees are an additional loss after negative saved gross. Foundational entry edge is weak; COST_DRAG_DOMINANT is not assigned solely from fixed-path raw-price accounting.
common_failure.buy_sell: BUY is worse in realized gross PF and average net trade for all three. SELL remains net-negative. Forward SELL superiority is not consistent: G SELL mean directional returns are worse than BUY at all horizons; E mixed. F has strongest direction-specific descriptive contrast.
common_failure.time: Losses concentrate differently: E12:30-13:29 ~48.7% of net loss; F first two buckets ~82.3%; G11:30-13:29 ~49.6%. Sparse positive E/F buckets do not show a shared time-of-day remedy or causal explanation.
common_failure.volatility: All nine family-by-tertile groups are gross and net negative. G LOW is particularly weak, but no common profitable regime or large-share causal explanation is established.
common_failure.cas: E/G CAS per-trade losses and PF improve; F worsens. All six legacy/CAS gross and net results remain negative. Small and chronological/confounded samples; no common material structural improvement established.

decision.evidence: Across families the fixed-horizon directional magnitudes are weak relative to measured friction; G lacks mean edge and E is unstable. F SELL is a descriptive pocket but insufficient to choose direction removal or exit redesign. No robust positive pre-exit expectancy supports prioritizing stop/target research.
future_hypotheses: A future preregistered entry hypothesis must demonstrate directional magnitude relative to unchanged execution costs on independent data.
F direction asymmetry and modest pre-stop favorable movement may be recorded as observations for that future protocol; no rule, parameter or filter is proposed.
